options.title: LG Sound Suite
options.desc: The moment your space and sound get "in tune." Experience premium home audio perfected with LG Sound Suite.
result: After a long day, your home transforms into your very own premium listening space.

LG Sound Suite tunes the sound to fit your space and speaker placement,delivering crisper dialogue, sound effects, and background music tailored to your content.Hear for yourself how the exact same content sounds completely different depending on the space.

options.title: StanbyME 2 Max

options.title: LG UltraGear
options.desc: The moment your gameplay and LG UltraGear screen get "in tune." Experience the difference in rapid response and sharp motion.
result: The shorter your gaming sessions at the end of a busy day, the more crucial fast response times and deep immersion become.
UltraGear achieves a native 1000Hz refresh rate without compromising FHD resolution,displaying frames and targets faster and clearer, even in highly dynamic scenes.
See the difference in speed as UltraGear’s screen perfectly syncs with your gameplay.

options.title: LG Gallery +
options.desc: An Art TV that tunes your space's ambiance to match your tastes and daily life. Discover the TV that transforms your home into your own personal gallery.

options.title: Fit & Max Refrigerator

result: When living alone, keeping ingredients fresh can be quite a challenge.
The Convertible Drawer applies the optimal storage temperature for each ingredient,helping to maintain freshness longer and reduce food waste.
Experience smart food storage perfectly tuned to your personal eating habits.

options.title: Fit & Max Dishwasher

result: Even if you eat alone, washing dishes is a daily recurring chore.
AI Sense Clean analyzes the soil level to apply the perfect wash cycle,while QuadWash and TrueSteam combine to deliver powerful cleaning and delicate dish care.
Experience Superior Performance, Yet Gentle Care.

options.desc: The moment heading out and home management get "in tune." Experience the AI Home Solution with Claw, which manages your home based on the situation even while you're away.

ThinQ Claw recognizes when you are out and switches appliances to energy-saving mode, while simulating occupancy at night using lights and the TV to keep your home safe.

options.desc: The moment your dining lifestyle and kitchen get "in tune." Experience smart meal preparation, from ingredient-based menu recommendations to cooking.

ThinQ Claw understands the ingredients in your refrigerator and seamlessly guides you—from menu recommendations to cooking and storage.
